content: मर्कटः .²1 An ape, a monkey; हारं वक्षसि केनापि दत्तमज्ञेन मर्कटः . लेढि जिघ्रति संक्षिप्य करोत्युन्नतमासनम् <ls>Bv. 1. 99</ls>. .²2 A spider. .²3 A kind of crane. .²4 A kind of coitus or mode of sexual enjoyment. .²5 A kind of poison. .{@-टी@} .²1 A female ape. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of various plants. .²3 An iron bolt.
